name: overridecheck
description: Verifies that npm package.json "overrides" actually took effect in package-lock.json — resolves each override rule against the real lockfile tree and flags the ones that silently did nothing.
author: overridecheck

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:dist
